mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior month, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.0% for two consecutive months, it indicates a weakening labor market that typically precedes corporate earnings deterioration and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE has exceeded 8.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts below 750.0 thousand units and retail sales below 400,000 million dollars signals a contraction in consumer demand that typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST < 750.0 and RSAFS < 400000.0, or Rank IC for interaction term over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, as indicated by a federal funds rate above 4.5% sustained for three months, the S&P 500 typically experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to higher discount rates and reduced corporate investment.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods classified as monetary tightening cycles, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 98.0 index points over the prior month indicates a weakening manufacturing sector that typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue growth expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO has declined below 98.0, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 750.0 thousand units for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in the housing market that typically precedes a slowdown in consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST has fallen below 750.0 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth below 100,000 jobs and unemployment rate above 8.0% signals a deteriorating labor market that typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS < 100000 and UNRATE > 8.0%, or Rank IC for interaction term over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, as indicated by GDP growth above 3.0% annualized and industrial production above 100.0 index points, the S&P 500 typically experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to profit-taking and the onset of monetary tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods classified as late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
